scripts.release: VITE_BASE=/tamra/ vite build && mkdir -p release/tamra/tiles && rsync -a --delete --exclude tiles dist/ release/tamra/ && cp boat.png release/tamra/ && rsync -a --include=tile_index.json --include='h_*.webp' --exclude='*' tiles/ release/tamra/tiles/
scripts.release:zip: npm run release && cd release && rm -f tamra.zip && zip -q -9 -r tamra.zip tamra -x 'tamra/tiles/h_*.webp' && ls -lh tamra.zip
scripts.release:tile:zip: npm run release && cd release && rm -f tamra-tile.zip && zip -q -9 -r tamra-tile.zip tamra && ls -lh tamra-tile.zip
scripts.lint:deps: grep -E '^import' src/state.ts && { echo 'state.ts must have zero imports (순환 방지)'; exit 1; } || exit 0
